title: Mixed Berry and Banana Yoghurt Smoothie with Orange
summary: Banana is blended smooth with honey and a pinch of salt, then frozen mixed berries, whole-milk yoghurt and orange juice are blended in until thick.

ingredients.item: ripe banana (about 120 g peeled), broken into chunks
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Blend the banana
steps.text: Put the banana, honey and salt in the blender and blend for about 10 seconds until smooth. Doing this first means no banana lumps later.

steps.title: Add the berries
steps.text: Add the frozen berries, yoghurt and orange juice and blend for about 1 minute until completely smooth and thick, scraping down the sides once or twice. If the blender stalls, add 1-2 tbsp more orange juice.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pour into the glasses straight away and top with a few fresh berries if you like.

tips: Frozen berries make the smoothie cold and thick without diluting it with ice.
A very ripe, freckled banana gives the most sweetness, so you may need less honey.
The pinch of salt doesn't make it salty; it just makes the fruit taste brighter.
Use Greek yoghurt for an even thicker, higher-protein smoothie.
storage: Best drunk within 30 minutes; it separates on standing. Stir or re-blend briefly if needed. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
